name: CSV catalog
description: Looks up products in a local CSV file. Offer import and export stay on an API data source.

settings.label: CSV file
settings.hint: The first row is the header. Code is required before this data source can search.

settings.label: Category
settings.hint: When no column is chosen, the quantity export leaves category out and totals by code and unit.

settings.label: Unit price
settings.hint: When a column is chosen, the quantity export adds this price and the total for each material.
